label: Every CONTINGENCY_1 being at w is existentially receptive or has a PRIOR_1 distinct esse CAUSE_2
paraphrase: OPEN (C2), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate that exists at w and is absent at some world accessible from w (MODAL_CONTINGENCY_1 on the frame's world-relative existence) either is existentially receptive (its esse is received in some principle that stands in receptive potency, RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_1 of De ente c.3, to that esse; or it is composed of matter and form) or has some other being that causes its esse (CAUSE_2 at esse, tenseless) and is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it. The 'relevant' receptivity is typed no further than this: any receiving principle in receptive potency to the being's esse, or any matter-form composition, satisfies it. 'Receptive' is not POTENCY_1 at esse: the receiving principle may actually have its act, while unactualized POTENCY_1 at esse is incompatible with actual existence (R2 law of the First Way reception controls). The matter-form disjunct keeps C2 faithful for accounts without a real essence-esse distinction. C2 is weaker than R1 with De ente and than B2 with B3 (both imply it), is independent of the pure-act target at w (controls, potencyOnly and angelic models), and says nothing about beings present at every accessible world.
